description: This is a React TSX source file for the main application component of a Next.js front-end project. It manages the UI workflow for uploading documents, generating a persona draft, displaying progress, and handling user interactions. It integrates with backend APIs for orchestration, persona management, and versioning, orchestrating a multi-step persona creation flow with state management and UI rendering logic.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: Type defining the application's current operational state ('initial', 'processing', 'draft', 'finalized').

classes.name: Experience
classes.description: Interface representing a work experience entry within the persona data.

classes.name: PersonaData
classes.description: UI model for a persona, including fields like name, title, skills, experiences, and profile image.

classes.name: UploadedFileData
classes.description: Structure representing uploaded files with unique ID and file object.

methods.name: asStringArray

methods.name: safeJsonStringify
methods.description: Stringifies a value into JSON with indentation, with fallback handling.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts a user-readable message from an error object or string.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a non-null object with at least one key.

methods.name: getInitials
methods.description: Generates initials from a label (e.g., username) for avatar display.

methods.name: getNestedOrchestrationValue
methods.description: Safely accesses nested properties in an object given a path, returning value and path.

methods.name: logAvailableKeys

methods.description: Extracts persona JSON data from an orchestration record using a prioritized candidate list.

methods.name: App
